name: YIELDSTREAM
description: $YSTR is the native utility and governance token powering Aura Network, a high-throughput Solana Layer 2 scaling solution designed to bring ultra-low latency and infinite scalability to decentralized applications. Built to eliminate network congestion and optimize state compression, Aura Network acts as a specialized execution layer for next-generation Web3 gaming, high-frequency DeFi, and real-time consumer dApps on Solana.
